description: This source file defines the Category class within the OpenCart admin catalog model. The class provides methods for managing product categories, including adding, editing, deleting, repairing categories, and handling associated data such as descriptions, layouts, SEO URLs, filters, and store associations.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents product category management within the OpenCart admin catalog model, providing CRUD and maintenance operations for categories.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database, including descriptions, hierarchical path, SEO URLs, layout, filter, and store associations, and then returns the new category ID.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category's data, including descriptions, paths, SEO URLs, layouts, filters, store associations, and handles related path and URL cleanup.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Removes a category and all related data such as descriptions, filters, store associations, layouts, SEO URLs, and descendant categories.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Recursively repairs category hierarchy paths, ensuring parent-child relationships are consistent.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes store associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a specific category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Adds a layout for a specific category, store, and layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes layout associations for a specific category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all category layout associations for a specified layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves the layout IDs associated with a specific category, indexed by store ID.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total number of category-layout mappings for a specific layout ID.
